message: An authentication cookie (its name has session, sess, sessid, sessionid, phpsessid, sid, token, auth, authtoken or jwt as a whole word) is set without httpOnly, with httpOnly false, with no secure option or with secure false. Without httpOnly a script can read it, so one XSS steals the session, and without secure it also travels over plain HTTP. Set httpOnly true, secure true (or an environment check) and a sameSite value.

message: Checks for setting the environment variable NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED to 0, which disables TLS verification. This should only be used for debugging purposes.
